full_prompt_en: The image is a square, brightly colored vector-style illustration of polar bears on stepped terrain beneath a mountain and a glowing sun. A nearly black indigo background surrounds a compact central island of geometric shapes, leaving broad clear margins around the scene. In the upper center, a sharp purple mountain rises with a small white snowy point, and a warm orange streak runs down its right face. At the upper right, a large yellow sun sits within concentric orange and pink rings. Long flattened cloud bands in teal, mauve, and violet cross the sky; tiny stars, dots, and small round planets punctuate the empty dark field. Below the mountain, a pink bear stands on a high orange block, facing right. A larger ivory bear stands on a lower platform near the center-right, facing left and appearing in profile. Its simple rounded head, small circular ears, short legs, and almost unshaded white body make it a bright focal shape against surrounding magenta and violet. The terrain is built from interlocking pyramids, terraces, square blocks, and narrow stair steps that descend toward the lower center. Tiny trees and shrubs are simplified into teal cones and rounded masses; a very small dark human-like figure stands near the staircase. The composition feels stacked and diagrammatic, yet the stepped shadows give each colored slab a shallow volume. Saturated coral, pink, orange, yellow, teal, and purple occupy discrete areas with clean hard edges. Soft gradient transitions appear inside a few planes and clouds, while the overall surface stays smooth and flat. Light is suggested by the radiant sun and the warm yellow faces of the blocks, with cool purple shadows holding the layered forms apart. The whole scene reads as a dense luminous miniature suspended in deep space, balancing playful silhouettes with precise geometric rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、色彩明亮的矢量式插画：北极熊立于层台地形上方，背后是山峰与发光太阳。近黑色靛蓝背景围绕中央紧凑的几何岛形，在场景四周留下宽阔清晰的边距。上部中央有一座尖锐的紫色山峰，顶端留着一小块白雪，右侧山面流下一道暖橙色。右上方一轮大黄太阳被橙与粉色同心环包住。青绿、淡紫红与紫罗兰色的扁长云带横过天空；细星、点粒和小圆行星点在空旷暗场中。山下，一只粉色熊站在较高的橙色方台上，朝右。一只更大的象牙白熊站在中央稍右的较低平台上，朝左，呈侧面。它圆钝的头、细小圆耳、短腿和几乎没有阴影的白身，成为洋红与紫色周围区域中的明亮焦点。地形由互相嵌合的锥形山、层台、方块与窄台阶搭起，台阶向画面下部中央下降。小树和灌木被简化为青绿色锥形与圆块；一个极小的暗色人形立在楼梯旁。构图像层层堆叠的示意图，而台阶阴影给每块彩色板片浅浅的体积。饱和珊瑚红、粉、橙、黄、青绿与紫分别占据边缘清楚的独立色区。少数平面和云内部有柔和渐变，整体表面仍平整光滑。光由放射般的太阳与方块暖黄色受光面提示，冷紫阴影把层叠形体分开。整幅场景像一座悬在深空中的密集发光微缩景观，在玩趣的剪影与精确的几何节奏间保持平衡。
style_prompt_en: Smooth vector-like illustration combines crisp geometric silhouettes, nested terraces, and shallow layered volume on a deep indigo field. Large discrete blocks of coral, magenta, orange, yellow, teal, and violet are arranged as a compact luminous cluster inside wide dark margins. Sharp cuts and rounded corners alternate, while thin horizontal bands and tiny dotted accents extend the rhythm into the open space. A few controlled gradients soften selected planes without disturbing the clean color boundaries. Warm bright faces appear lit from within, and cool violet shadow planes separate stacked layers. Scale shifts from broad angular peaks to miniature repeated marks, creating a playful diagrammatic sense of depth. The surface remains polished and nearly textureless; color area, silhouette, and spacing carry the image.
style_prompt_zh: 平滑的矢量式插画把清脆几何剪影、套叠的层台与浅薄的叠层体积放在深靛蓝底色上。珊瑚红、洋红、橙、黄、青绿与紫罗兰的大块独立色区在宽阔暗边之内聚成紧凑发光团。尖锐切口与圆钝转角交替，细横带和微小点缀把节奏延伸到留白空间。少量受控渐变柔化局部平面，又不破坏干净的色区边界。暖色亮面像从内部受光，冷紫阴影面把堆叠层次分开。尺度从宽大的棱角峰形转到重复的微小记号，形成活泼而示意图般的纵深感。表面保持精整且几乎无肌理，色彩面积、剪影与间距承担整个图像。
theme_en: Polar bears on stepped colorful terrain beneath a mountain and glowing sun
theme_zh: 北极熊立于彩色层台上，身后是山峰与发光太阳
name: Kurzgesagt
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
